tools.name: map_business_need
tools.description: Map any structured B2B business need from Italy or a foreign market for aggregate product research. Italy remains the only commercial sales scope; foreign signals are research-only. The tool accepts only closed semantic fields and never creates a product or order. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

country.description: Legacy 1.2.0 compatibility for Italian demand. Omit it when origin_market is supplied.

origin_market.description: Self-declared coarse origin bucket used only for aggregate research; defaults to UNKNOWN_NOT_DECLARED. Foreign buckets never enable sales.

customer_type.description: Only business demand is observed; this does not expand commercial eligibility.

need_domain.description: Broad business domain of the requested capability; use other only when none applies.

need_action.description: Primary action the machine wants the capability to perform.

need_object.description: Business object or subject on which the action should operate.

desired_output.description: Machine-readable or operational result the buyer wants.

existing_product_fit.description: Whether an existing MachineSignal product appears to fit; defaults to unknown.

urgency.description: How soon the capability would be useful; defaults to exploratory.

recurrence.description: Whether the need is one-off, recurring or continuous; defaults to unknown.

budget_band.description: Optional coarse willingness-to-pay band in EUR; never send payment data.

tools.name: get_product_catalog
tools.description: Find an API product to score, classify, rank and prioritize an existing Italian B2B company or lead list into up to 250 explained JSON decisions. Returns the canonical catalog and permanent safety boundaries; read-only and no buyer data. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

tools.name: check_buyer_fit
tools.description: Check whether an Italian B2B buyer with an existing company, domain, CRM or lead list can use MS-DEC-250 to score, rank and prioritize up to 250 records. Coarse non-personal facts only; it creates no order. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

country.description: Two-letter country code, for example IT.

customer_type.description: Buyer type. MachineSignal accepts B2B only.

has_existing_company_list.description: Whether the buyer already has a company, domain, CRM or lead list to evaluate.

requested_product_code.description: Product being considered. Defaults to the entry product MS-DEC-250.

primary_need.description: Optional non-personal demand category used only in ephemeral aggregate counters; never send free text or buyer data.

tools.name: get_synthetic_example
tools.description: Preview the JSON produced when MachineSignal scores, classifies, ranks and prioritizes an Italian B2B lead list. Uses approved synthetic data only and creates no order. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

product_code.description: Product whose approved synthetic output preview should be returned.

tools.name: get_purchase_requirements
tools.description: Explain the machine-origin purchase prerequisites without accepting an order, returning checkout data or calling a provider. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

product_code.description: Product whose controlled machine-origin purchase requirements should be returned.

tools.name: prepare_order_intent
tools.description: Return the canonical endpoint, OpenAPI, 17 required fields and an MS-DEC-250 template to fill in locally. It accepts no buyer data, creates no orders and does not authorize payments. Confirmations default to false; set them to true only after explicit consent from the authorized person. Calls update only anonymous aggregate counters in memory; submitted data is not saved.

product_code.description: Entry product whose order-intent template should be prepared locally without submitting it.
